Diagram of the reproductive tract of a laying hen. At the top left, a cluster of yellow yolks of different sizes attached to the ovary. Below it, a funnel-like opening (Infundibulum) catching a yolk. The tube then thickens and coils heavily (Magnum), narrows slightly (Isthmus), expands into a large muscular pouch containing a fully formed egg (Uterus/Shell Gland), narrows into a short Vagina, and ends at the Cloaca (Vent).
